headline: Iran Warning To US: Threat Rises Again in Middle East! Iran's Direct Warning to America, Says 'Allied Countries Will Also Be Considered Part of the War'
summary: Iran warned the United States and its allies that American bases and interests in West Asia would be targeted if new military action is taken. Tehran said US-allied regional states would also be considered participants.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key route for seaborne oil and LNG shipments, so tensions there are closely watched by energy markets.
why_moved: The input reports that tensions around the Strait of Hormuz have increased, threatening regional energy shipping.
